meta_description:
9,777 likes, 66 comments - petermckinnon on August 16, 2026: "First slide, middle shot- that’s the inside of a vinyl cover if I’ve ever seen one 😱 Absolutely love it. It was too dark for the xpan during the show so I took the shot anyway with its near 3 second exposure and just physically panned right to create that drag. 

I did not expect it to turn out so epic. @cinestillfilm 800t was the move. Fired up on these! Analog strikes again. 💪🏻🫡🇮🇸

Dev & scan : @graination_official".
